prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one transparent PNG giant brown rat miniature token for a square-grid tabletop RPG, clearly readable at 64px with a recognizable outline at 48px.
Primary request: create a NEW giant brown rat token whose round ears and long bare tail make it immediately distinct from the canine and bear tokens.
Input images: Image 1 is ToME's original giant brown rat sprite, used only for the identity and anatomy: a long low brown rodent with a pointed snout, round ears, short clawed feet and a long mostly bare tail curling behind it. Do not copy any blue edge from this tiny sprite. Image 2 is the accepted brown bear miniature, used ONLY for the painted miniature material, steep high-angle camera, upper-left light, neutral grey-brown thin round base and framing. Do not use bear anatomy.
Subject: exactly one large brown rat, with an elongated low body, sloping back, visibly round thin pink-brown ears, a long narrow pointed nose, modest whiskers, four short rodent feet with visible digits, and a very long tapering naked ring-textured pink-brown tail. The tail bends in a broad clear arc along the inner far edge of the disc, separate from the furred body. Fur is earthy brown with broader buff dry-brushed planes over the shoulders and back; a lighter muzzle, bare ear interiors and pale digits are readable accents. The head faces toward the lower left, alert and slightly lifted. Keep rat proportions: a narrow skull, low stance and long bare tail, not a small wolf, fox, hamster, mouse mascot or bear cub. Let the animal and tail use the available inner disc without making the creature tiny.
Style/medium: matte hand-painted carved tabletop miniature, broad sculpted fur planes and restrained surface detail. Distinct, simple species silhouette; no photoreal hairs.
Composition: square image, one full circular base and one full animal only. Match Image 2's base size, neutral thin rim, centered framing and steep high-angle view. Every ear, foot, whisker and the entire tail remain inside the outer base boundary. Leave only a narrow band of visible base around the creature.
Lighting: soft upper-left illumination; short contact shadow on the disc, none beyond it.
Backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha outside the base. No simulated checkerboard or solid background.
Constraints: no blue outline, no coloured faction ring, no glow, no status or rank symbols, no text, no watermark, no armour or props, no grass, no stones, no extra rats.
reference_roles: original ToME giant brown rat sprite; species identity and bare tail anatomy only
accepted brown bear miniature; camera, painted material, lighting and neutral base only
review: Round ears, narrow pointed muzzle, bare digits and earthy fur read as a rat. Failure: the bare tail is visibly disconnected from the animal, with two free tapered ends; it reads as a separate worm on the disc. Needs a targeted tail attachment edit before selection; body, pose and base can be preserved.
image_processing: Copied original generated PNG without pixel edits, resizing, background extraction or alpha modification.
